outcome: Risk factors associated with third- or fourth-degree perineal tears (34DPT)
finding: In a tertiary medical center with a low cesarean section rate, factors associated with 34DPT differed between patients with and without operative vaginal delivery: gestational age over 39 weeks and birth weight over 3500 g were associated with 34DPT in those without operative deliveries, while gestational age, episiotomy, and diabetes were associated with 34DPT in those with operative deliveries.
mod_finding: Operative vaginal delivery was associated with an increased risk of 34DPT, and episiotomy was associated with an increased risk of 34DPT in the context of operative delivery.
